text: {"question":"What weighted mean offset is applied to the DES distance moduli to bring them into the H0DN magnitude convention, and how many of the 196 overlapping supernovae have had their magnitudes altered by a host‑property correction?","reference_answer":"The offset applied is a weighted mean of −19.3766 mag, and 36 of the 196 overlapping supernovae have had their magnitudes changed by the host‑property correction."}
